title: 5c-7: convention waiver tracking
description:
## Parent

sutra/57 — 5c PRD: convention system design

## What to build

Waiver tracking for convention violations. A waiver annotates a deviation as "reviewed and intentional" — it doesn't suppress the finding.

Key pieces:
- `convention_waivers` table (durable): convention_id TEXT, symbol_qualified_name TEXT, component_id TEXT nullable, rationale TEXT, waived_by TEXT, waived_at TIMESTAMP
- References use qualified_name / convention_id (not integer PKs — survives reindex)
- MCP tool: waive a violation (convention_id + symbol + rationale), list waivers, revoke a waiver
- Review output: waived violations appear as "waived: {rationale}" instead of as violations, but remain visible
- Reconciliation: orphaned waivers (convention_id no longer exists) surfaced alongside orphaned convention_state entries

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] convention_waivers table created via durable migration
- [ ] Waivers stored by convention_id + symbol qualified name (not PKs)
- [ ] MCP tool: create waiver, list waivers, revoke waiver
- [ ] Review/check output annotates waived violations with rationale
- [ ] Waived findings remain visible in reports (not suppressed)
- [ ] Orphaned waivers surfaced by reconciliation pass
- [ ] Tests: waiver creation, waiver annotation in check output, orphan detection

## Blocked by

- sutra/58 (module rename)
implementation_plan:
Wave 1-2: migration 0018_convention_waivers.sql, TABLE_REGISTRY entry, ConventionWaiverRow + 5 Db methods (create/list/revoke/waivers_for_check/reconcile_orphaned), 3 new sutra_conventions actions (waive/list_waivers/revoke_waiver).

Wave 3: Review pipeline partitions violations by waiver status — unwaived stay in convention_violations, waived move to waived_violations with rationale. Waived violations don't affect risk_score. Supports bare name, file-qualified, global, and component-scoped waiver matching.

Wave 4-5: Orphan detection mirrors reconcile_orphaned_states pattern. Tests: CRUD, uniqueness upsert, component scoping, orphan detection, reindex durability."

Codex review (sutra/61+62+64 combined):

Verdict: needs-attention

Finding relevant to 5c-7:
- [medium] Waiver reconciliation misses symbol-orphaned waivers (src/db/conventions.rs:461-468). reconcile_orphaned_waivers only checks convention_id existence. Waiver whose symbol was renamed/deleted while convention remains active is not surfaced as orphaned — stale waiver stays in waivers_for_check and can silently apply to a later symbol with the same name.
